question: With 100M events rows published as Parquet and Forge compaction on, does open-loop mixed ingest at 70% of calibrated capacity beside mixed queries offered open loop at 12/s with at most 32 in flight keep point p99 under 5 ms, dashboard p95 under 100/300 ms, heavy scan p95 under 2 s, server write acknowledgements p99 within 100 ms, with every answer exact, every client-queue row durable exactly once, a bounded backlog, a declared queue-full refusal only under overload, and the SLOs restored within 30 s after it?

timing.method: server benchmark histograms: integer nanoseconds from the owning server boundary's std::time::Instant timers, recorded into bounded HDR histograms and read as cumulative snapshots from the loopback metrics listener; each window is the bucket-count difference of two snapshots of one process
timing.precision: 3 significant digits; each percentile is judged on its whole bucket's bounds
timing.percentile: nearest rank ceil(q * N) over the window's distribution
timing.tracing: operator span export stays at its default (disabled); no span is required for timing
timing.assignment: every request carries its closed case and the repetition or admission phase that admitted it, activated once its caller authenticated; a window takes the observations recorded between its opening snapshot and one taken after its admitted cohort drained, so a late completion stays in its admitted cohort; each cohort's judged-outcome count must equal the completions the driver saw, other outcomes (retried or refused attempts) are counted beside it; a short or extra count, a dropped or out-of-range observation, an unknown label, a missing or negative component, scans that are not the answered cohort's, or a replaced process makes it invalid
timing.measurement: work, wall seconds, and server and driver CPU stop at the admission stop, before the requests then in flight drain; their completions count as late work beside the measured work, and their latency stays in the final cohort
timing.evidence: each window's full opening and drained snapshots are kept under the run's target artifacts as timings/<step>/<phase>.json; the record keeps each cohort's reconciliation and each percentile's rank and bucket bounds

workload.ingest: open loop by rows: 50% OTLP spans, 30% OTLP logs, 20% native writes; Forge compaction enabled (trigger 2 snapshots) on every ingest table
workload.queries: open loop at 12 queries/s independent of answers, at most 32 in flight (a due query finding 32 unanswered is missed): 60% point lookup, 25% dashboard (15% 100k-row, 10% 1M-row aggregate), 10% whole-table aggregate, 5% full scan
workload.client_queue: three lanes, each a fresh WyrdState per repetition: headroom 1,000 obs/s, ack-delay 500 obs/s behind a 50 ms acknowledgement proxy, in-flight 500 obs/s with max_in_flight 1
workload.phases: capacity 5/12 of the window; overload fills Oracle's 1,000 queue places behind held slots while ingest continues, then one more query; recovery to the window's end
